tagline.en_US: Search the web through a self-hosted Google results frontend without displaying ads or requiring client-side Google scripts. This recipe enables the optional built-in login.

description.en_US: Whoogle Search is a privacy-focused frontend that delivers Google search results without advertisements, tracking cookies, JavaScript, or AMP links. It strips user-identifying data, blocks tracking tags, and prevents requests from being linked to the client's IP address. It can be integrated as a primary search engine on desktop and mobile browsers, supporting search bangs and proxy routing.
